args.message:
Bump fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays. Versions <2.9.4 are affected; 2.9.4 contains the fix.

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 → 2.9.4 (fixes CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades the fastjson dependency from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Security
Fixes **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions are `<2.9.4`; this PR pins 2.9.4, which contains the fix.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.

2. **Branch**: Created `upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4` from `main` and committed the change to `requirements.txt` (`fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`), with a commit message describing the CVE.
